title: TickDataV1
description: Production-grade market tick data contract. Deterministic scaled integers only. Compliant with rust-policy.yaml v1.0.

price_scaled.description: Price in smallest currency unit (e.g., 1 BTC = 100_000_000 satoshis). Scale factor per exchange defined in configs/exchanges/.

volume_scaled.description: Volume in smallest asset unit. Scale factor per exchange defined in configs/exchanges/.

timestamp_ns.description: Nanoseconds since UNIX epoch. Must be monotonic within same symbol stream.
